name: @balena/promise-queue
description: Queue sync or async functions with max concurrency, max size, max age, and fifo/lifo ordering
author: Pagan Gazzard <page@balena.io>

scripts.prepare: node -e "try { (await import('husky')).default() } catch (e) { if (e.code !== 'ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND') throw e }" --input-type module
scripts.lint: npm run build && balena-lint -t tsconfig.test.json src/ test/ && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
